license_required.quote: a person may not engage in the practice of optometry or purport in any way to be an optometrist or an expert in the field of optometry without having first obtained a license from the Oregon Board of Optometry

type.quote: The Oregon Board of Optometry operates as a semi-independent state agency

degree_required.value: graduation from a school of optometry approved by the Oregon Board of Optometry with a standard of four school years of at least nine months each
degree_required.quote: graduation from a school of optometry that is approved by the Oregon Board of Optometry and that maintains a standard of four school years of at least nine months each

exams.name: Oregon Board of Optometry examination
exams.notes: Applicant shall be examined in anatomy of the eye, use of pharmaceutical agents, refractive and accommodative conditions, subjective and objective optometry, fitting of glasses, lens grinding and frame adjusting, and other subjects pertaining to optometry
exams.quote: Any person who has signified to the Oregon Board of Optometry a desire to be examined by it and who has filed proof that the person is qualified under ORS 683.010 to 683.340 and the rules of the board to take the examination shall pay a fee to be determined by the board

exams.name: National Board of Examiners in Optometry
exams.notes: Board may accept in lieu of its own examination in certain areas
exams.quote: The board may, in its discretion, require the certificate of successful examination of the National Board of Examiners in Optometry in one or more areas of the examination in lieu of its examination in such areas

exams.name: Pharmaceutical agents examination
exams.notes: Required for those seeking to prescribe and administer pharmaceutical agents
exams.quote: Any person who petitions the board to prescribe and administer pharmaceutical agents who has not previously been examined by the board on such use shall pass an examination on the use and potential side effect of such agents as used in optometry

exams.name: Oregon optometric law and administrative rules examination
exams.quote: Passes a written examination approved by the board on Oregon optometric law and administrative rules

interval_years.quote: Attendance at any approved courses or other approved means of continuing education are to be certified to the board upon a form provided by the board and shall be submitted by each optometrist at the time designated by the board but in any case no less frequently than once every two years

required.quote: All optometrists licensed in the State of Oregon are and shall be required to satisfactorily complete courses of study and satisfactorily continue their education by other means as determined by the Oregon Board of Optometry

period_years.quote: shall be submitted by each optometrist at the time designated by the board but in any case no less frequently than once every two years

available.quote: The Oregon Board of Optometry may grant to an applicant a license by endorsement for the practice of optometry in the State of Oregon if the applicant: (1) Holds a license for the practice of optometry obtained by examination in another state of the United States

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a license obtained by examination in another state, continuously engaged in practice for not less than two years, have equivalent educational qualifications, meet Therapeutic Pharmaceutical Agent certification requirements, pass written examination on Oregon optometric law and administrative rules, submit documentation of continuing education hours equivalent to Oregon requirements, and pay application fee
requirements.quote: Holds a license for the practice of optometry obtained by examination in another state of the United States. Any discipline or sanction related to the practice of optometry imposed upon the applicant by any state licensing agency must be disclosed on the application for licensure; (2) Continuously engaged in the practice of optometry for not less than two years immediately preceding the application to the board; (3) Has educational qualifications the board considers equivalent to the educational requirements necessary for licensing by the board at the time the applicant commenced the practice of optometry

exists.quote: The Oregon Board of Optometry operates as a semi-independent state agency subject to ORS 182.456 to 182.472, for the purpose of carrying out this chapter. The board consists of five members appointed by the Governor

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: An optometrist treating a patient with antiglaucoma medication shall consult with an ophthalmologist if: (A) The glaucoma progresses despite the use of two glaucoma medications; (B) More than two medications are required to control the glaucoma; or (C) A secondary glaucoma develops

value: Schedule II drugs prohibited except those on the optometric nontopical formulary and Schedule II hydrocodone-combination drugs

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: Every person desiring to commence the practice of optometry or employ the use of pharmaceutical agents shall in addition to the requirements of subsection (1) of this section: (a) Have satisfactorily completed a course in pharmacology, as it applies to optometry, by an institution accredited by a regional or professional accreditation organization that is approved by the board with particular emphasis on the application of pharmaceutical agents for the purpose of diagnosis and treatment in the human eye, approved by the board; and (b) Demonstrate to the satisfaction of the board clinical competency in the prescription of pharmaceutical agents listed on the optometric nontopical formulary

specialty_certification_types.quote: Meets the requirements for Therapeutic Pharmaceutical Agent certification established by rule by the board

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: To prohibit vision or eye care practices by persons working under the direct supervision of an optometrist authorized to practice in this state

telemedicine_authorized.quote: "Practice of optometry" includes the prescription of Schedule II hydrocodone-combination drugs for the purposes listed in this subsection and the use of telemedicine as defined in ORS 683.230

spectacle_prescription_release_required.quote: Immediately upon completion of the necessary visual examination or examinations performed by a licensed optometrist, the optometrist shall provide the patient with the appropriate written prescription for correcting refractive errors, if any, in the eyesight of the patient

impaired_practitioner_program_establishe.quote: The health professional licensing boards may establish or contract to establish an impaired health professional program to assist licensees who are unable to practice with professional skill and safety by reason of habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs, alcohol or other substances that impair ability or by reason of a mental health disorder.

limited_teaching_license_available.quote: Any optometrist licensed in another state, while a professor or instructor in such a college, may sign optometric prescriptions on behalf of the clinic, but not otherwise

retired_license_status_available.quote: Each optometrist who is retired, has a disability or is a nonresident of the State of Oregon and who is not practicing optometry within this state shall on the date established by the board pay a license fee, as determined by the board, for a renewal of the license of the optometrist
